reuse.why: Builds the new rule on the existing getRangeAmount and getApproxNumberThreshold and routes getScheduledAmount through it, but computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in the same file keeps its own getRangeAmount dispatch.

duplication.why: Replaces four inline missing/number/range dispatches with one getPlannedAmount; the preview path's dispatch remains as a leftover copy.

placement.why: getApproxAmount/getPlannedAmount live in shared/schedules.ts next to getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Changes are on-topic, though stale 'rounded midpoint' comments in schedules/app.ts are left and the boolean inverse positional arg is spelled out at every UI site.

maintainability.why: A single planned-amount definition with getScheduledAmount delegating to it is easy to own; two public entry points and the missed preview site are the weak spots.

bypasses_abstraction.where: computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in shared/schedules.ts still resolves the amount with its own null/number/getRangeAmount ternary instead of getPlannedAmount

one_place.where: Rule is in getPlannedAmount (shared/schedules.ts) used by getScheduledAmount, api-models, forecast, schedule-template and schedules/app.ts, but computeSchedulePreviewTransactions bypasses it and keeps the range-only rule
